payload.body: Brief read, and on it in your order. **Your question, answered from the code: after WP11 no replayed case reaches the legacy engine or any legacy script.** The one native path left into the fallback is contact log --email (src/contact.rs:433). The one golden that passes --email, contact-log-email, starts with 'email recent', and email is not native until WP14, so the replay skips that whole case. I will measure it as well, in the WP11 clone: with every bin/pplr_* script and lib/engine.sh's build turned into exit 99, every replay test must still pass. Your causes match my read of the logs, with one addition: the port race became likely at b663b95 because the warm-up's OnceLock released every replay test at the same moment. Next: the port race alone, in a clean clone from main. I am asking you for cargo now.
